svg.title: Before and after
svg.desc: A stiff 74-word email full of stock phrases such as 'I hope this message finds you well' and 'it is crucial to highlight' becomes a 25-word email: 'Hi team, the quarterly meeting has moved to Thursday, 14 March, at 10:00. Attendance is mandatory for all team leads. Thanks, Priya.' The date, time, 'mandatory', 'all team leads' and the sender are kept exactly.
